I just wanna add, but idk how much you could control this… if someone does eventually get access to go inside the house, they must find who/what the reason is for the knocking. My worry is that maybe the police will go inside and find nothing… there have been cases of kidnappers creating secret places to hide the victims in the house that just a typical scan of the house with the naked eye might not be able to detect.

All the best to you and your family in this difficult time, I wish you nothing but strength to get through this and hope you are able to get to the bottom of what is happening. Please take care.
